people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
translations.bsb: Now Samuel was ministering before the LORD—a boy wearing a linen ephod.
translations.kjv: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
translations.asv: But Samuel ministered before Jehovah, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
